vigenteDescricao: Your subscription is active and renews on {{data}}.
inadimplenteDescricao: We could not complete the payment. Your lines stop sending and receiving messages until the charge is settled.
canceladaDescricao: Your subscription was cancelled and the period ended on {{data}}. The lines are still here, but they do not send or receive messages.
testeExpiradoDescricao: Your trial period ended on {{data}}. The lines are still here, but they do not send or receive messages until you subscribe.

contratar.descricao: Your line sends and receives messages again as soon as the payment is confirmed. Credentials, settings and the linked channel stay as they are.

processandoDescricao: We received your payment and are unlocking your line. This usually takes a few seconds — you can stay on this screen.

erroCheckout: We could not start the checkout. Please try again.
erroPortal: We could not open the billing portal. Please try again.
checkoutDescricao: Fill in your payment details below. Your line starts working again as soon as the payment is confirmed.
checkoutErroTitulo: Could not open the payment form
checkoutSemChave: Card payment is not configured in this environment. Contact support.
